fn resource_driver_build(cli:*CCli)->i32 {
    var driver:*CDriver = &(*cli).driver;
    var context:*RmdContext = (*cli).stage.status.context;
    var resources:RsStage = uninit;
    rs_init(&resources, context);
    if (*cli).root != null(*RmdSource) {
        if !rs_read(&resources, (*cli).root, (*cli).target_begin, (*(*cli).root).size) {
            return 1i32;
        }
    }
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*cli).source_count {
        var source:*RmdSource = &(*cli).sources[index];
        var bytes:*u8 = null(*u8);
        var size:usize = 0usize;
        if rmd0_host_read_file((*source).path, &bytes, &size) != 0i32 {
            c_driver_io_error(driver, "cannot read input", (*source).path, *c_driver_errno());
            return 1i32;
        }
        (*source).bytes = rmd_try_copy_string(context, bytes, size);
        (*source).size = size;
        rmd0_host_free(bytes);
        if (*source).bytes == null(*u8) { return 1i32; }
        if !rs_read(&resources, source, 0usize, size) { return 1i32; }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if !rs_prepare(&resources) { return 1i32; }
    if !c_driver_exports(cli) { return 1i32; }
    if (*cli).mode == 3u32 { return 0i32; }
    if !c_driver_names(driver) { return 1i32; }
    var entry:*RmdDecl = null(*RmdDecl);
    if !(*cli).library {
        entry = c_driver_entry(cli);
        if entry == null(*RmdDecl) { return 1i32; }
    }
    if (*cli).mode == 4u32 {
        if c_emit_with_body(&(*cli).stage, entry, rs_c_body, &resources as *u8) { return 0i32; }
        return 1i32;
    }
    return c_backend_build_with_body(context, entry, (*driver).options, rs_c_body, &resources as *u8);
}

// Require an initialized context with no application units and retained source storage.
// Arguments are compiler options and extra source paths, without an executable name.
// Complete the selected output before return. Keep diagnostics in the caller's context.
// Use the lower-level stage API when cleanup plans must remain available after the call.
fn resource_program(request:*RmdBuild)->i32 {
    var context:*RmdContext = (*request).context;
    var cli:CCli = uninit;
    var success:bool = c_driver_init(&cli, context, (*request).argc);
    cli.root = (*request).source;
    cli.target_begin = (*request).target_begin;
    var result:i32 = 1i32;
    if success && c_driver_parse(&cli, (*request).argc, (*request).argv, 0i32) {
        result = resource_driver_build(&cli);
    }
    c_stage_destroy(&cli.stage);
    return result;
}
